object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Record a snapshot of the previous release (v0.3.0): its list_tools inputSchema, the result fields of one successful and one failed call of each tool, and the error_type values. Commit the snapshot as test data and compare the current server with it. Expected: each snapshot tool, parameter, type and default is offered unchanged; each optional parameter is still optional; each result field and error_type is still returned by the same call. A one-off comparison of inputSchema on 2026-11-11 found only additions: outline's root and depth, both with default null, and compare_document. Result fields and error_type values weren't compared.
